author: peterthepeter; based on work by meldavy
name: Decaid MQTT Bridge
description: Publish complete Decaid telemetry and controls to MQTT with optional Home Assistant auto-discovery.

Host.label: Broker host
Host.description: Hostname or IP of the MQTT broker. Empty disables the integration.

Port.label: Broker port
Port.description: MQTT broker port. 8883 for TLS, 1883 for plain TCP.

ClientId.label: Client ID
ClientId.description: MQTT client ID. Leave empty to use the auto-generated unique ID.

TopicPrefix.label: Topic prefix
TopicPrefix.description: Prefix for state and command topics. Leave empty to use de1plus/<unique id>.

EnableTls.label: Use TLS
EnableTls.description: Connect to the broker over TLS.

HaAutoDiscoveryEnable.label: Enable Home Assistant auto-discovery
HaAutoDiscoveryEnable.description: Publish retained Home Assistant discovery entities. Disable and save before changing brokers or uninstalling.

HaDiscoveryPrefix.label: Home Assistant discovery prefix
HaDiscoveryPrefix.description: Must match the discovery prefix configured by Home Assistant.

HaEntityNamePrefix.label: Home Assistant entity name prefix
HaEntityNamePrefix.description: Prefix shown before each discovered entity name.

HaDeviceName.label: Home Assistant device name
HaDeviceName.description: Leave empty to derive the device name from the connected machine model.
